panel.title: Snowglobe
builder.confirmDelete: Click the same snowman again to delete it
builder.hint.move: Drag a ball; hold Shift to move the whole snowman
builder.hint.decorate: Pick an accessory, then click the snowman
builder.hint.delete: Click a snowman, then click it again to delete
builder.hint.roll: Drag across a pile of snow to roll a snowball; drop it on another ball to stack
builder.hint.rolling: Keep moving over the snow to grow the ball, release to drop it
builder.noSnow: No snow here: move along a pile on a window top or the ground
bar.tooltip.blocked: Snowfall held back: this compositor would draw it as a black screen — right-click for details
panel.blockedHelp: Snowfall is off because Hyprland is not giving this shell transparent buffers, so the overlay would cover your desktop in black. Set quirks:skip_non_kms_dmabuf_formats to false (or update Hyprland to 0.57.1+), restart Hyprland, then restart the shell.
